# CAMF industrial assembly study data (author-collected)

Multimodal study of intended workpiece selection for industrial human-robot assembly.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Gaze, body/hand motion and object pose during an instructed reach.

**Output / label:** The intended component among the seven assembly workpieces.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10339)

**Example evidence:** [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.10339)

## Intention in this dataset

The instructed target workpiece is an operational object goal. Recognition during the reach is early action recognition; it is not evidence of spontaneous mental-state inference.

**Relevance:** `explicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2026

**Domains:** industrial_collaboration, human_robot_interaction  
**Intention types:** object_interaction, collaborative  
**Tasks:** goal_recognition, early_action_recognition  
**Modalities:** object_state, gaze, pose, imu  
**Formats:** time_series, structured_annotation
